scope: Read-only frozen raw epoch300 ROI model; 108 fixed strong-augmented train images, isolated CPU FP32, B36 batch BN, same protocol as existing ROI signal probe; no parameter updates or checkpoint writes
limitations: Auxiliary classifier was trained on region averages, not point vectors; its point-readout gap is not itself evidence that dense detection is deficient.
Point classification accuracy is not AP; locations were selected by GT matching.
One converged checkpoint on augmented training samples does not establish an online teacher advantage across training or generalization.
